blocks.text: The icon turns 20. This milestone took center stage during Kojie.san’s recent 20th-anniversary celebration. Evolving from the cult-favorite kojic soap that started a skincare revolution, the brand is celebrating more than just a single success story. It marks two decades of beauty innovations and groundbreaking achievements. “Kojie.san cannot simply exist by being a successful product. It has to exist as a successful organization [that’s] built around a successful product,” shared Jean Thor Renzo Burila, Executive Director of Basic Integrated Global Inc. Over the past 20 years, Kojie.san has evolved alongside changing beauty trends without losing its core identity. The brand seamlessly […]...
